answer.reason: The request is for a new slide in a product screenshot slider. On this instance, the rotating-slider pattern is the Carousel component (reference name "carousel"), and its slides are the Carousel Slide model ("carouselSlide", content definition "Carousel Slide"). Its fields (heading, description, background image, CTA, CTA text override) fit a screenshot slide. The alternatives don't fit: BentoCard and GalleryImage are for cards or grids shown together, not a rotating slider, and FeatureItem is for icon-based features. I did not save anything.
